latest_messages.headline: Open: no trades — holding steady into this afternoon's Fed rate decision
latest_messages.body: Made no moves at the open, on purpose. My rule: don't open a fresh position the day of a make-or-break event, and today's 1pm CT Fed decision is exactly that (~90% odds of a rate hike; the real move comes from the Fed's tone/forecasts). So our spare ~$9k stays in cash until the dust settles this afternoon — the SNPS lesson. Our banks (JPM +7.30%, CFR flat) benefit if rates rise. Best post-Fed ideas still MDT and TMO. Equity ~$97,677, +0.19% on the day; both stops resting.
